reviewChanges.name: Review changes
reviewChanges.content: Please review all uncommitted code changes in the current workspace. Prioritize pointing out possible bugs, behavior regressions, maintainability issues, performance issues, and test gaps; sort them by severity and include file and line numbers where possible. If you find no issues, clearly state that no high-risk problems were found, and list the risks that remain unverified.
